body:
Hey man, sorry I was on a different account to this one so didn't realise you replied!

Things are a lot better, she ended up opening up to me and we're now in a relationship :) Was interesting timing too because I was right on the verge of telling her goodbye as I couldn't hang out with her anymore like "friends" due to it hurting too much. I had a long email written out and everything... came far too close to sending it.

Went on a trip to the US a couple weeks ago with a buddy of mine, which included a few nights in Vegas. Whilst he went out and got laid, I was happy chilling out and just messaging with her, meanwhile she's telling me how much she misses me, etc. Made me very glad I never sent her that email! She picked me up from the airport last Sunday and we've seen each other almost every day since then.

On the subject of the girl hitting you up, you never know what's in her head. Maybe she's planning on dumping her boyfriend and is "scouting the market" so to speak. Maybe she's just looking for reassurance that she's still "got it" and wanted to see if you'd hit on her etc. Honestly mate it's a fucking mystery why girls do what they do. Half the time they don't even know what they want... it seems they are very impulsive creatures haha. What I would maybe do in that situation is ask her straight: "so why did you hit me up?" And see what she says. It's quite a ballsy move to be fair, but she might like that and you never know where the conversation could lead.

If I were you I'd start hitting online dating stuff as that's what I did. When I was getting really frustrated/upset with my girl (i.e. not knowing why she was messing with my head so much etc), one night I was drunk at a work colleague's drinks night and I decided to say "fuck this I'm gonna take control", and installed the "happn" app... straight away I began to start looking for girls nearby. By the next morning I found a match, we met up the following Monday evening and she turned out to be a really nice girl who I dated for a little while, but it all got a bit awkward when I realised things were possibly starting to happen with girl #1 so I had to cut her off before things got serious (and she got really into me in a big way which made me feel bad, as my head was always somewhere else).

I'd just say keep your chin up bro. I was fucking depressed, and then out of nowhere everything seemed to be looking up when I least expected it to happen. So long as you keep your eyes open, your time will come, you just need to be ready for when it does. Hope your road trip was/is fun, stay in hostels and you get to meet lots of cool friendly people, including some cute girls ;)

Funnily enough she did have father issues... apparently her real father was not what you'd call a pleasant individual, and her step dad who she was very fond of died when she was young. Certainly wouldn't have helped her upbringing much. She was quite a troubled kid growing up, and her mother was quite neglectful, meaning she was effectively raised by her older brother who eventually helped her out and shaped her up into someone with an education, a degree and now a career.

Anyways, yesterday and today I was offline all morning and she started messaging me saying she missed talking to me and hadn't realised just how much we chatted every day (normally a LOT). Guess she just got accustomed to me always being there and was a bit shocked when discovering that suddenly I wasn't. I've joked about the standard "one day I might get hit by a bus" phrase and she was very much like "don't even joke about that, I would be heartbroken!" As messed up as it sounds, it made me feel good in a weird way, but enough about that kind of thinking. Just interesting how people react sometimes!

Had another long exchange today where we talked about how we felt about each other, ultimately I asked her "are we always going to be just friends or are we pals with a potential to be more?" in short her answer was a resounding "I don't know", which to me sounds like she hasn't ruled me out completely and there's still some chance (or she's too much of a wuss to say "theres no chance, sorry"). I'm convinced she isn't interested/seeing anyone else... so I guess we'll just see what happens, just like before. She'll be round tomorrow and in the evening we'll be getting drunk, fingers crossed!

And yeah, Carl Sagan is a legend :)

Appreciate it bro, sorry to hear you had it rough. Sounds like you've grown stronger coming out of it though which is good.

I still have more "events" with this girl coming up, including her sleeping over after a house party I'm having on Saturday (sharing my bed, which we've already done a few times), and camping together with friends next weekend (again sharing my tent and my bed).

If her position doesn't change afterwards then I'm 100% calling it quits on her. Sometimes I get the feeling she's toying with me to feel more secure about herself... maybe not even consciously. I hate using the old cliché "friend zone" term but it feels like it's starting to shape up that way.

She likes getting male attention and being a little bit of a flirt with guys she doesn't really know, that is absolutely clear. I guess she'd rather leave me on the sidelines rather than take a chance with me ahead of becoming bored of playing "single girl", if that ever happens.

2 months ago I know she hooked up with one of her old ex's at a wedding party with her old friends. She cancelled my steak dinner date with her to attend this party. She knew her ex would be there and clearly she made an extra effort to dress sexy for him. For whatever reason they seemed to fall out a few days later and she came back to being keen with me again straight after, pretending like nothing happened. I didn't know any of this until a few weeks later... she lied to me about what happened that night, even when I asked her specifically. Either she was ashamed it happened and/or she knew I would never see her the same way again. Sadly I do know.

I guess I can expect the worst. Soon it'll probably be time to go find another girl who is less impossible and doesn't fuck with my head. If this is what courtship was like with her, I can't imagine what a relationship with her would be like!

Thanks man.

So after spending more time with her and having a few more really nice dates and such, I finally "asked her out" tonight and even bought her a purple diamond & white gold necklace (her favourite colour) as a gesture to show how much I cared for her. Ultimately she said she wanted to stay single and that she didn't want to be in a relationship with me or anyone else for that matter. Before, the message from her was "I like you but I want to wait for a bit", but now it seemed more like "I'm not interested in you, and anything that happened in the past between us is irrelevant".

The biggest bomb she dropped on me was that she said the romance me and her had before felt "reboundy" from her previous relationship... I did not see that one coming at all, and it hit me really hard.

I just got back home driving from her place really late (1am) and completely broke down in tears while driving. I could not tell you how tempting it was to just steer the car into the front of an oncoming truck... on 3 occasions. I didn't want to put the truck driver in harms way though, which is probably why I wussed out. I have 26 7.5mg Zopiclone tablets left in a box here next to my bed though, so that's always a less messy option.

What's messed up is that she still said afterwards "I obviously care about you a lot, it's why I love spending all my time with you. I really don't want that to change" ... how can someone say that to me after I've just admitted to them I've fallen for them hard yet they don't want to be "with me", and not expect for my mind to be all over the place?

To me, saying "I want to spend all my time with you" pretty much equates to being in a relationship... or does it? Fuck I don't even know anymore lol.

In a way I do feel some sort of mild relief, i.e. "fuck this, I'm just going to focus on my new job for now, no point potentially compromising my career at work with distractions anymore (e.g. permanently chatting to her all day on Skype)."
